core_obligations: Prove the forward direction: continuity/openness, affine open inside the component, irreducible closure with nonempty open interior.
Prove the surjective direction: Noetherian open meeting Z, component removal, preimage component and its closure.
proof_roadmap: topology lemma + affine open argument + surjective component lifting
difficulty_reason: Both directions fully executed: forward - the topological map is continuous and open (named properties-of-stacks lemma), an affine open inside the component gives an irreducible image containing a nonempty open, and a closure containing a nonempty open is a component; surjective direction - choose a Noetherian open meeting the component, remove the other components, take the closure of an irreducible component of the preimage open, and conclude the equality of closures by construction.
